Streaming chat completion that includes a usage summary in the final chunk

```swift title="Swift"
import Foundation
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.chatCompletionRequestFromJson("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Say hi\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\",\"stream\":true,\"stream_options\":{\"include_usage\":true}}")
guard let _apiKey = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["API_KEY"] else { fatalError("API_KEY must be set") }
let _client = try createClient(apiKey: _apiKey, baseUrl: nil)
let result = try await _client.chatStream(_req)
var chunks: [LiterLlm.ChatCompletionChunk] = []
        for try await _chunk in result { chunks.append(_chunk) }
for resultChunk in chunks {
    debugPrint(resultChunk.usage?.totalTokens as Any)

}
```
